title: Google Ad Grants
description: Up to $10,000 per month in free Google Search advertising credit for eligible nonprofits, through Google for Nonprofits. Rolling applications, no deadline. Governmental entities, hospitals, and schools are not eligible.
eligibility: Registered 501(c)(3) nonprofits with a quality website; must enroll in Google for Nonprofits.

title: AWS Imagine Grant
description: Annual AWS grant for nonprofits using cloud technology and AI for social good: up to $200,000 in unrestricted funding plus up to $100,000 in AWS credits, depending on category. The 2026 cycle is closed; the next cycle is expected to open in spring 2027. Sign up on the program page for alerts.
eligibility: Nonprofits with registered 501(c) status based in the US; educational institutions excluded.

title: Okta for Good product donation
description: Eligible nonprofits receive 50 free Okta Workforce Identity licenses and 50% off additional licenses and Auth0 plans, plus free training. Rolling; apply through Okta for Good or TechSoup.
eligibility: Validated 501(c)(3) nonprofits (verified via Goodstack); hospitals, healthcare, schools, and government entities ineligible.

title: Twilio.org Impact Fund and Impact Access Program
description: Twilio.org funds nonprofit tech projects in digital transformation, humanitarian assistance, and climate action. Impact Fund grant rounds are currently invitation-only; the Impact Access Program is open and provides product credits and discounts to eligible nonprofits.
eligibility: Public benefit nonprofits (501(c)(3) and equivalents); government and political organizations ineligible.

title: TechSoup donated and discounted software
description: TechSoup is the main directory of donated and discounted software and hardware for nonprofits (Microsoft, Adobe, Okta, and hundreds more). Registering your organization is free and also validates your nonprofit status for many other programs, including Google for Nonprofits.
eligibility: Registered 501(c)(3) nonprofits and public libraries.
